summary: Right of Micro and Small Enterprises to 25% government procurement under MSMED Act; enforceability of Procurement Order 2012; minimum turnover clauses in tenders challenged as violative of Articles 14, 19; such clauses held disproportionate and arbitrary if not linked to product value; institutional mechanisms under Procurement Order 2012 upheld with directions for effective implementation; judicial review extends to structural and functional efficacy of designated bodies.
legal_provisions_cited: Constitution of India Art.14, Art.19, Art.32
final_judgment: Petition allowed in part; directions issued for effective implementation of Procurement Order 2012; minimum turnover clauses to be proportionate to tender value; Review Committee and Grievance Cell to be operationalized; respondents to consider bids of MSEs without disproportionate eligibility criteria.
